items.question: For a Change of Control under the MSA, whose voting rights have to be acquired, Harrowgate's or Voss-Lindqvist's?
items.answer:
The documents indicate that a "Change of Control" is defined as any transaction by which a person or group acquires more than fifty percent (50%) of the voting rights of Provider [1: "Change of Control" means any transaction by which a person or group acquires more than fifty percent (50%) of the voting rights of Provider].

The Master Services Agreement (MSA) requires the Provider, Harrowgate Systems Inc., to provide notice of a Change of Control to the Client, Voss-Lindqvist AB, in accordance with Clause 22 [6].

The documents do not explicitly state whose voting rights have to be acquired, only that the definition of "Change of Control" refers to the Provider's voting rights. Therefore, based on the sources provided, it is the Provider's voting rights that must be acquired for a Change of Control to occur.
